selection.rule: Dependency-complete first 24 questions from the question-sheet selection order.

questions.question: What kind of beginning appears at the start of the passage?
questions.answer: It begins with praising Allah, asking Him for help, and sending blessings and peace on Prophet Muhammad, his family, and his companions.

questions.question: What does the passage show about the source of real help?
questions.answer: It shows that help is sought from Allah.

questions.question: Which groups connected to the Prophet are mentioned with him in the prayer for peace?
questions.answer: His family and his companions.

questions.question: What did the speaker decide to give after being asked?
questions.answer: He decided to give a few truthful pieces of advice.

questions.question: Are the truths presented as one long speech or in another form?
questions.answer: They are presented as eight short stories.

questions.question: What kind of comparisons are used in those stories?
questions.answer: Comparisons connected to military life.

questions.question: Who is said to need the advice most?
questions.answer: The speaker says his own nafs needs it most.

questions.question: Why is using ordinary language important in this passage?
questions.answer: It makes the advice easier to understand for regular people.

questions.question: What can we infer from the line inviting others to listen together?
questions.answer: The advice has a wider benefit and can speak to more than the one person first addressed.

questions.question: How does the speaker describe the style of the present advice?
questions.answer: He says it is brief and in plain language.

questions.question: What are the first lines of the passage mainly doing?
questions.answer: They are opening with du‘a, praise, and respect before the advice begins.

questions.question: How is Allah described in relation to creation?
questions.answer: He is described as the Lord and Sustainer of all worlds.

questions.question: What title is given to Allah that shows His care over everything?
questions.answer: He is called the Lord and Sustainer of all the worlds.

questions.question: What simple request started this whole response?
questions.answer: A request for some advice.

questions.question: How many short stories are promised in the advice?
questions.answer: Eight.

questions.question: Why are those stories given in a military style?
questions.answer: Because the person being addressed is a soldier.

questions.question: What made the earlier advice valuable to the speaker?
questions.answer: It came from Qur’anic verses that had benefited him personally.

questions.question: How is the present version different from the earlier one?
questions.answer: This one is shorter and simpler.

questions.question: What does the phrase about benefiting from those verses tell us?
questions.answer: It tells us the speaker was personally helped by those Qur’anic teachings.

questions.question: Who is invited to listen along with the speaker?
questions.answer: Anyone who wishes may listen together with him.

questions.question: What three acts of worship or devotion appear in the opening lines before the advice starts?
questions.answer: Asking Allah for help, praising Him, and sending blessings on the Prophet.

questions.question: What does the phrase about seeking help teach a believer to remember first?
questions.answer: It teaches a believer to turn first to Allah for support.

questions.question: How does the passage honor Prophet Muhammad?
questions.answer: It asks for blessings and peace upon him, his family, and his companions.

questions.question: What had the brother asked the speaker to share?
questions.answer: A few words of advice.
